title: Yellow Molten Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Rich and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring chicken skewers with a molten yellow sauce, perfect for a brunch mood, grilled to perfection on a yakimono grill with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, yellow food coloring, turmeric, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the molten yellow sauce by heating the remaining marinade in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the chicken is cooked, brush the molten yellow sauce onto the skewers.
Serve the yellow molten Brazilian chicken skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions.
